title: Space Tech Briefing — September 03, 2026
summary:
Good morning, space cadets, and welcome to your daily dose of cosmic currents! It's Thursday, September 03, 2026, and we're kicking off your day with some absolutely stellar news from Earth and beyond. Get ready to launch into orbit with the latest in space technology!

First up, mark your calendars and set your coordinates for Le Havre! This September, science is truly climbing "On the Shoulders of Giants." We're talking about a fantastic scientific event dedicated to the wonders of science and, of course, space exploration. The French space agency, CNES, is proudly associated with this exciting manifestation. It’s a brilliant opportunity to dive deep into the cosmos right from the heart of France. Expect groundbreaking discussions, innovative insights, and a celebration of all things space. Don't miss out if you're in the region!

And speaking of groundbreaking, let's talk about our very own European Space Agency astronaut, Sophie Adenot! She's done it again, completing her *third* spacewalk outside the International Space Station this past Tuesday, September 1st. This was EVA 99, and Sophie was the undisputed leader! Donning the red-striped spacesuit, signifying her role as EV1, she was the first to emerge from the Quest airlock, spearheading critical maintenance operations for the ISS. Her extravehicular activity lasted an impressive 6 hours and 49 minutes, showcasing incredible skill, endurance, and precision. Sophie Adenot is not just performing tasks; she's making history with every step she takes in the vacuum of space. What an incredible achievement!

That's all for your morning space briefing, folks! Keep looking up, keep dreaming big, and we'll catch you back here tomorrow for more exhilarating news from the final frontier. Have a truly stellar day!
